description: pwrsys-matlab, published by efantnu, provides MATLAB and Simulink blocks for power systems with converter-interfaced equipment, developed by NTNU doctoral researchers. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: CC0-1.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The authors explicitly say the library is incomplete and not thoroughly documented, tested or optimised; MATLAB toolboxes are required. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
